flows:
Navigate to https://map.openseamap.org/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
First assert the View menu control in the main map toolbar is keyboard focusable.
Open View with Tab and Enter.
Verify the Sea Marks checkbox appears as an available layer control.
